name: star-writing-skills
description: A controlled research-writing workflow that maps papers before editing, preserves accepted project decisions, and gates evolution on evidence and user authorization.

interface.shortDescription: Understand first. Decide together. Evolve through evidence.
interface.longDescription: A modular research-writing system for read-only paper onboarding, interactive proposition and terminology control, framing, literature positioning, method and evidence audits, drafting, approval-gated revision, purpose-specific review, live submission checks, project Writing Ledgers, and user-authorized workflow evolution.
defaultPrompt: Start read-only, map this paper and its evidence, and recommend the next defensible step.
Help me converge on the story and establish load-bearing writing decisions before drafting.
Preview evidence-grounded revisions and apply only the items I approve.
